messages:
lucy_sales: POC customer (acct=acct_POCX) reporting free credits vanished overnight and they saw a ton of 429s during load test. demo tomorrow. can we swarm and figure out billing explanation? :sweat_smile:
henry_support: on it — ask them for SDK version, concurrency pattern, and a small log window. also ask if they used any job replayers or autoscalers.
lucy_sales: customer pasted logs and says python-sdk v1.3.7 and they run a cron job that retries failed tasks. log excerpt:
```
2026-03-25T19:42:10Z INFO send req tokens=1600 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-03-25T19:42:12Z WARN timeout, retrying
2026-03-25T19:42:15Z INFO send req tokens=1600 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-03-25T19:42:18Z INFO success req_id=req_xyz tokens=1600
```
mira_engineer: thanks. early signal: repeated token-sized requests + timeouts => likely duplicate billing. pulling server-side log window 2026-03-25T19:40-19:50 for acct_POCX.
paul_finance: metering summary: acct_POCX used 31,200 credits between 19:30-20:00. free_credits at 19:30 = 32,000. quota_bot, any spend alerts triggered?
quota_bot: soft spend alert fired at 2026-03-25T19:44 for acct_POCX; pattern: repeated identical token counts (1600) within 8s intervals.
mira_engineer: server log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-25T19:42:10Z] req=req_x1 status=408 tokens=1600
[2026-03-25T19:42:15Z] req=req_x2 status=200 tokens=1600
[2026-03-25T19:42:20Z] req=req_x3 status=408 tokens=1600
[2026-03-25T19:42:25Z] req=req_x4 status=200 tokens=1600
```
mira_engineer: that's 2 full duplicates in 15s. given the cron replayer pattern they described, looks like background retries replaying tasks while original still processed. SDK v1.3.7 doesn't set idempotency header — known issue.
henry_support: action items: 1) advise customer to pause cron/replayer for POC, 2) upgrade SDK to v1.4.x (automatic idempotency) or set X-Idempotency-Key per request, 3) we'll offer temporary concurrency bump to avoid 429s while they patch, 4) finance to review credit. ops_bot: can you raise concurrency?
ops_bot: accepted change: concurrency for acct_POCX increased 4 -> 16 for 12h. ticket: infra_adj_20260325_11.
paul_finance: propose goodwill credit to cover duplicated consumption after dedupe analysis. estimated duplicate tokens = ~15,600 units. will queue approval.
lucy_sales: i'll tell the customer: pause replayer, upgrade SDK, we queued a credit and bumped concurrency for 12h. they'll want exact numbers to show their execs before demo.
mira_engineer: quick dedupe calc: total billed 31,200; unique accepted request count appears to be ~15,600 if deduped, so duplicate ~15,600. recommended credit = 15,600 units and restore free_credit to pre-spike level for demo.
paul_finance: billing_bot queued credit: acct=acct_POCX amount=15600 reason="likely duplicate consumption from cron replay + missing idempotency" status=pending_approval.
henry_support: also adding KB note so sales/SEs can warn customers: - background job replayers can double-bill - use X-Idempotency-Key or sdk >=1.4 - soft alerts can be lowered for POC to catch spikes early - prefer checking request status endpoint instead of blind retries.
lucy_sales: customer replied: "Thanks — pausing replayer and upgrading now. Appreciate the credit and the concurrency bump. We'll re-run the load and confirm." :pray: closing loop unless finance needs more info.
paul_finance: I'll push approval through and update thread when credit posts. audit note: cause=client-side retries; mitigation=KB + SDK upgrade recommendation.
mira_engineer: long-term engineering note: propose short server-side dedupe window (2-5s) for identical payloads without idempotency on POC tier to reduce consumer-facing surprises. filing RFC.
lucy_sales: thanks team — saved the demo. marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
